# Spells List
Summons a grasp-like spell focus to your hand. It needs blood to cast spells, feed it from a living being's blood or a puddle on the ground.
It can also be used to heal cultists, constructs and yourself. Healing yourself is 2x less effective.
Can be used on some objects like airlocks and plasteel, turning them into cult versions.
[bold]This is how you get [color=#dc143c]runed metal[/color]![/bold]
[bold]It can also transmute cyborgs into constructs![/bold]
Cuffs and mutes a victim with ethereal [bold]shadow shackles[/bold], which disintegrate if removed so they can't be used against you.
This only works if the victim is [bold]already stunned[/bold], consider using the stun spell or a trusty batong.
Knocks down, mutes and marks the victim. Keep hitting marked target with cult weapons until they are stunned. Borgs get stunned for lengthy duration under the effect of this spell instead of getting marked. [color=red]Important:[/color] Cannot be used via context menu, but it does work in [color=red]Combat Mode[/color], which only works on mobs and cannot miss.
Can be cast on yourself or a fellow cultist, teleporting them to a teleport rune of your choice after a few seconds.
Creates a 20 second EMP instantly, taking out sec's batongs and such.
Gives you another ritual dagger incase you lost the one you spawned with.
